notes.title: Crankage Games Bundle on Sale + Next Game!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! I just wanted to thank you all for your continued support! All 6 of our games in the bundle have had overwhelming feedback and we truly appreciate each and every one of you!

Our bundle is currently on sale here: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/7659/The_Terrible_Metal_as_Phuk_Deported_Tale_of_Damned_Daniel_Chronicles_of_Quiver_Dick_Collection_Bundle/

And I'd just like to announce that the next game we're working on, we're doing with fan interaction! We're streaming game development each week, LIVE on twitch here: https://www.twitch.tv/crankagegames

Where fans of the game can help craft the game world itself, and even be characters IN the game! I feel like this is a great opportunity for developer and fans to interact, come together, get to know each other, and build something awesome. I'd love to talk to each and every one of you, so if you're ever interested in dropping in and not just WATCHING game development, but actually being a part of the process, please feel free to do so, because I'd LOVE to talk to you!

Thank you so much, and keep being amazing!

- Crankage Games / Michael
https://twitter.com/CrankageGames[/b]

notes.title: Happy Holidays + We now have a Patreon!
notes.content:
[b]Good news everyone and Happy Holidays to all!

We've been asked for a while now if we'll ever set up a Patreon, and now we've finally got one!

If you'd like to support what we do to ensure we can continue putting out comedy games in the future, then we'd like to support you right back!

[list]
[*] Want a twitter shoutout for your contribution? Sure.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Want to enter Giveaways on twitter? You got it.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Want to ask Quiver D!ck a question and have it answered in a custom comic strip posted on Patreon and Twitter, (As well as featured in an upcoming new episode of The Chronicles of Quiver D!ck?) You can ask him ANYTHING you want!
[/list]

But it doesn't end there! Not only do we have options for all of the above for those who choose to support us going forward, but there's ALSO the potential for your name to be listed in a link RIGHT on the title screen of The Chronicles of Quiver D!ck along with your social media, channel links, or anything else you'd like people to see!

Like I said, you want to support us? Well we want to show you that we appreciate you just as much as you appreciate us!

You can find our Twitter links and Patreon below!

Happy Holidays everyone!

- Crankage Games[/b]

https://www.patreon.com/CrankageGames

https://twitter.com/CrankageGames

notes.title: Damned Daniel is Officially Live!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! A new developer, [u]Red Mouse Games[/u], has JUST released her very first game, [u]Damned Daniel[/u]!

It will be 40% off for launch week and available for purchase in the Crankage Games bundle as well!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/932500/Damned_Daniel/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/7659/The_Metal_as_Phuk_Deported_Chronicles_of_Quiver_Dick_Collection_Bundle/

[u]Red Mouse Games[/u] has done some of the artwork found in previous Crankage Games titles such as Metal as Phu.k and The Chronicles of Quiver D!ck, (As well as the new up and coming Metal as Phu.k game scheduled for release in early 2019!)

I'm honored to have had a hand in the writing of this new adventure, so if you're a fan of previous works from Crankage Games, then I think you'll have a great time with [u]Damned Daniel[/u]!

She's worked very hard over the last year to bring her dream to fruition, so I hope everyone gives her game a chance! She'd absolutely be thrilled to hear your feedback!

Thank you all so very much for your continued support, it truly means a lot!

- [u]Crankage Games[/u][/b]

notes.title: Your Feedback on MaP + New Game Coming!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! Thank you so much for showing interest in Metal as Phu.k! I'd just like to post this here for those who don't know where to leave a review of your thoughts on the game!

http://store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/662210

Reviews are what keeps developers alive and kickin', and regardless of how long or short your review is, I -DO- want to read it and I absolutely -WILL- be responding to it! 

The positivity, love, and support you've all shown along the way has been uplifting and appreciated! The next game will have a Steam Store page soon! For those of you who have already played Metal as Phu k, you may recognize the main character of the upcoming RPG:

Quiver D.ick!

The Chronicles of Quiver D.ick is made up entirely of NPC's with names of those who supported Metal as Phu.k along the way! If you see your name in there, don't be surprised! However, if you don't see your name, don't worry, because this is only the first episode in the new series!

The Chronicles of Quiver D.ick will be a 1.5 hour crude comedy adventure rpg that focuses on the bat-shi.t crazy stories of Old Man Quiver in his youth! Each episode will be a stand-alone adventure, so you don't have to play any of them in any particular order to understand and fully enjoy the individual episodes!

The game will be priced at $1.99 upon release and launched with a discount for the first week so that many can enjoy the laughs in an affordable way!

Again, if you've played Metal as Phu.k, please feel free to leave your review in this link here: http://store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/662210

I will respond to each and every one of you and your support is greatly appreciated!

Thank you so much!

- Crankage Games

notes.title: As a Token of Gratitude...
notes.content:
As a token of my appreciation for all of the amazing support that you've all shown over the course of MaP, as well as the continued support that new players bring in, I've decided to add in a fair amount of characters into the next game being released by Crankage Games that are meant to represent those who helped along the way!

If you've done something to support the game in any way:

1. Thank you SO much, I really do appreciate the positive support you've given, (And the positive support that is still yet to come from those of you who are just joining the group!)

2. Don't be surprised if you see your names in the next game as a character or part of the storyline!

The next game will be a 3 part episodic comedy adventure that will not only make you laugh, but hopefully do a good job at honoring those who continue to support Crankage Games along the way!

3. Episode 1 is nearly finished and will be releasing as soon as possible! Episode 2 is also being fleshed out as we speak, and Episode 3 will follow soon after! (There's still room for characters to be added to the mix as the story was written with a handful of placeholder names for the time being, so if you don't see your name in Episode 1, that doesn't mean you won't in Episode 2 and 3!) 

I want to be sure to give back to the community that made all of this possible, as  MaP is now sold in over 90 different countries around the world! I really could not have done this without you!

Thank you!

- Crankage Games

notes.title: New Bonus Trailer + A Big Thank You!
notes.content:
A lot of time has been spent. A lot of work has been put in, but the trailer is finally complete and on the store page!

Thank you to everyone who has supported the game along the way! 
Whether it has been with shoutouts, advertising on your social media pages, in discord servers, sharing with your friends, streaming the game live, making youtube videos, and especially to those who have enjoyed the game enough to leave such kind words in the reviews.

You are truly what determines the success of the games we create! We owe you all a BIG thank you, and we have something very special we're working on in our next game to show appreciation for those who have supported the project and continue to support the project even now!

Truly and wholeheartedly, Thank you.

- Crankage Games
